intro: The Tome of Divinity is a pivotal trial undertaken by holy champions in Ironforge, culminating in a meeting with Tiza Battleforge. Completing the trial demonstrates worthiness to wield the Symbol of Life and unlocks the sacred power to resurrect fallen allies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.
Light be witcha, mighty adventurer. I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done all of Ironforge a great favor today, friend. I'm proud to count you among us, and if you feel you're ready, I would like to bless you with this scroll. The Symbol of Life would only have worked when used by a paladin who was ready for one of the Light's greatest blessings--the power to restore the dead back to life.
I will teach you the ability to resurrect your companions. Use it wisely, friend, and thank you, on behalf of myself, my husband, and Ironforge.
